data_fields.name: cost_resources
data_fields.donor_constant: mission.resources taken as a negative grant on accept

best_idea: Offer the next quest in a hut only after the reward (XP and level-up) has finished, and skip expired or one-shot quests on visit and on each new turn.
decision_why: The queue and the two-phase hand-off fit our rulings, but the donor takes the cost and marks completion in two separate writes and does not re-check requirements on accept; both must change to meet one ledger and server verification.
acceptance: A player at a seer-style NPC accepts a quest, the XP and level-up panel closes, and only then is the next quest offered; a repeatable-only queue does not re-offer on the same tile; a server test asserts that an accept with a stale requirement is refused and the cost is not taken.
